projects.name: Multi-Agent Intelligent ERP System - Agentic Al + Enterprise Resource Planning
projects.summary: Built a production-grade Multi-Agent ERP using a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with a Master Orchestrator and six specialized domain agents (HR, Finance, Inventory, CRM, Sales, Document) Master Orchestrator reads user queries, maps them via a structured router prompt, outputs JSON delegation payloads, and synthesizes cross-domain responses into a unified executive summary Analytics / CEO Agent computes cross-domain KPIs unavailable to any single department (e.g., Revenue per Employee, Cash Flow Pressure, Customer Acquisition Cost) and returns strict JSON schemas for live dashboard rendering Sub-Module Pattern: Python pre-crunches raw data deterministically (anomaly detection, churn prediction, stock. shortage modeling); LLM only receives statistical summaries eliminating hallucination on critical business data Demonstrated 99.9% time reduction vs. traditional analysis: complex cross-domain CEO queries answered in under 30 seconds vs. 4-6 days of human analysis Designed for enterprise scale: horizontal agent scaling, database sharding per department, async processing, audit trails, and on-premise LLM deployment for data privacy compliance
